mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sd_proofing_invitation_candidates WHERE invitation_id = #{invitationId} ORDER BY quote_submit_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT c.invitee_user_id, c.quoted_price, c.quoted_period_days, c.is_quote_batch_plan, c.tiered_pricing, c.profit_share_ratio, c.quote_submit_at, c.status, u.nick_name AS invitee_nick_name, u.avatar AS invitee_avatar FROM sd_proofing_invitation_candidates c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.invitee_user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.invitation_id = #{invitationId} ORDER BY c.status DESC, c.quote_submit_at DESC, c.id DESC

SELECT c.invitee_user_id, c.invitation_id, c.quoted_price, c.quoted_period_days, c.is_quote_batch_plan, c.tiered_pricing, c.profit_share_ratio, c.quote_submit_at, c.status, u.nick_name AS invitee_nick_name, u.avatar AS invitee_avatar FROM sd_proofing_invitation_candidates c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.invitee_user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sd_proofing_invitations inv ON c.invitation_id = inv.id WHERE inv.work_id = #{workId} AND inv.inviter_user_id = #{inviterUserId} AND inv.status IN (1, 4, 5, 6, 7) -- 查询进行中和已完成的邀约：已接受、待回应、已处理、待确认 ORDER BY c.status DESC, c.quote_submit_at DESC, c.id DESC
